Rule Label Resource Update Rule Label
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/ruleLabels/:ruleLabelId

Updates rule label information for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleLabelId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the rule label.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

The unique identifier for the rule label.

name
string

The rule label name.

description
string

The rule label description.

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the rule lable was last modified. This is a read-only field. Ignored by PUT and DELETE requests.

lastModifiedBy
object
createdBy
object
referencedRuleCount
int32

The number of rules that reference the label.
